issues.description: Payment validation handles raw card data at the application boundary.
issues.suggestion: Prefer payment-provider tokenization so raw card numbers do not need to be handled by application code.

issues.description: Expiry validation has a date-boundary assumption that deserves explicit testing.
issues.suggestion: Compare against an explicit end-of-month expiry instant and test boundary dates.

codeQuality.summary: The premium feature introduces payment, pricing, subscription, and access-control business logic.

untestedPaths.reasoning: Payment success, validation failure, insufficient amount, gateway failure, and upgrade paths are untested.
untestedPaths.suggestedTest: Mock the payment/database layer and test every success and failure branch.

untestedPaths.reasoning: Card length, CVV, expiry format, and expiry-date branches are security-sensitive.
untestedPaths.suggestedTest: Test valid cards, invalid lengths, invalid CVV, malformed expiry, and expired cards.

untestedPaths.reasoning: Tier pricing, tax, and processing fee calculations affect billing.
untestedPaths.suggestedTest: Assert exact pricing for premium and enterprise tiers.

untestedPaths.reasoning: Access control and subscription state determine paid feature availability.
untestedPaths.suggestedTest: Test missing subscription, expired subscription, allowed feature, and disallowed feature.

testCoverage.summary: The changed module explicitly contains no tests, leaving critical payment and access-control branches uncovered.

suggestions.description: Separate pure billing rules from database/payment orchestration.
suggestions.before: Business rules and side effects live together.
suggestions.after: Pure policy helpers plus a thin orchestration layer.
suggestions.benefits: Makes security-sensitive rules deterministic and easier to test.

suggestions.description: Hide provider-specific charging behind a small payment gateway abstraction.
suggestions.after: processPremiumPayment calls an injected gateway interface.
suggestions.benefits: Improves testability and isolates provider concerns.

refactorings.summary: Separate pure billing rules from external side effects so critical paths can be tested deterministically.

recommendations.description: Add tests for payment validation, pricing, gateway failures, successful upgrades, and feature access.
Prefer tokenized payment-provider flows so raw card numbers do not need to be handled by application code.
